# vendor/djaunt-branding

Files copied verbatim from [tory37/djaunt-branding](https://github.com/tory37/djaunt-branding)
at commit `f1ae85e`. Do not hand-edit them here; re-copy from upstream to update.

Vendored rather than linked from jsDelivr `@main` so an upstream change can't
restyle this site without a commit here.

| Path | Used for |
|---|---|
| `brand/tokens/tokens.css` | every color, type, space, and motion value on the page |
| `brand/logo/djaunt-icon.svg` | the mark in the header, hero watermark, and footer (as a CSS mask, so it takes the theme color) |
| `components/hero/` | the page-top masthead |
| `components/buttons/` | hero and contact actions |
| `components/badge/` | project type tags and skills |
| `components/section-nav/` | the sticky jump-link bar, with scroll-spy |
| `components/divided-list/` | education, certification, and the colophon list |
